nowlin-2001.citation: Nowlin, W. D., Jr., A. E. Jochens, S. F. DiMarco, R. O. Reid, and M. K. Howard (2001), Deepwater Physical Oceanography Reanalysis and Synthesis of Historical Data: Synthesis Report. OCS Study MMS 2001-064, U.S. Department of the Interior, Minerals Management Service, Gulf of Mexico OCS Region, New Orleans, 528 pp.
nowlin-2001.access: Original government synthesis report acquired and SHA-verified. Actual printed pages 170 and 174 (PDF pages 192 and 196) visually reviewed. Source interprets SAIC 1987–1988 current-meter observations; raw time series and contemporaneous closed eddy boundaries not acquired.

records.source_locator: Section 6.3.3.3, printed page 174 / PDF page 196, General description of records; named-case and station context on printed page 170 / PDF page 192.
records.period_label: mid-March through June 1988 source narrative; exact speed-window endpoints unspecified
records.definition: Source-described southward current speed at fixed mooring SAIC GG, instrument depth 100 m, during the named Kathleen passage. Mean versus maximum statistic is not specified.
records.scope: Named source-case measurement at a fixed current meter. Registry physical identity crosswalk unverified; instrument depth is sampling support, not eddy depth.
records.qualification: Finite mooring-site speeds, not whole-eddy maximum, surface speed, swirl-speed radius or center translation. No exact sample dates, raw profiles, simultaneous depth section, annual envelope, vertical boundary, lifetime or state footprint inferred. Source describes Kathleen coalescing with a smaller anticyclone in mid-March; no attribution of the resulting signal to an isolated pre-merger eddy.
